**First release for macOS 26 Tahoe.** The native kext is built for **25G241 (macOS 26.7.1)**. On any other build, read
[GUIDE §7](https://github.com/thanhnndev/mt7925-macos-wifi/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#7-other-macos-builds) first. For macOS 15 use `v1.1`.

> Experimental, AI-written, tested on one laptop (ASUS GA403WM). Kernel code: it can panic. Back up first and keep another way online.

### What's new since v1.1

* **Tahoe port of the native front end:** headers regenerated from the 25G241 kernel collection, beacon header 0x44, IE budget,
  CoreCapture pipes, and the link-quality event (no more drops after 60 s). Measured: 176.6 Mb/s down / 65.0 Mb/s up, HE 160 MHz 2×2,
  DFS channel 52.
* **Core:** cipher-aware keys (WPA/WPA2 mixed networks with a TKIP group cipher now work), AP table 48 → 128 (2.4 GHz networks no
  longer go missing in crowded places), group-TX wcid switch `itl_grp19` (default off).
* AWDL phase 2 (the `awdl0` interface) is included but **off** unless `itlmt_awdl=1`. Don't enable it for daily use.

Not yet: WPA3, open networks, 6 GHz, AirDrop, verified sleep/wake. See [ROADMAP](https://github.com/thanhnndev/mt7925-macos-wifi/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md).

**Install:** [docs/GUIDE.md](https://github.com/thanhnndev/mt7925-macos-wifi/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md) · [Tiếng Việt](https://github.com/thanhnndev/mt7925-macos-wifi/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.vi.md).
In `Kernel → Add`: `itlmt7925.kext` first, then `itlmt7925Native.kext` with `MinKernel 25.0.0`. Boot-args:
`itlmt_native=1 itlmt_native_if=1 itlmt_native_dp=1 itlmt_fast=6`.
